description: Get a ranked markdown digest of your most relevant persistent memory — what you would want loaded into your working context right now. Optionally pass a `query` to bias the digest toward a topic. This is the same memory block a voice/phone session injects so you act with full continuity.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

query.description: Optional topic to focus the digest on.

name: memory_context
